stories.groq_explain: This article is about a Gemini protocol server called Sula, which is written in a programming language called Scryer Prolog. stories.groq_explain: The core idea is to allow developers to run their own version of Cloudflare's Durable Objects, a distributed database service, on their own machines instead of in the cloud. This is achieved through a system called celld, which is an open-source daemon that runs on local machines and replicates data to an owned S3-compatible storage bucket. This allows for self-hosting and reduces the reliance on a shared database, making applications more resistant to failures and contention issues.
